intro.title: Small acts. Lasting change.
intro.description: Explore the projects your support makes possible, from daily meals and classrooms to healthcare that reaches the people who need it most.

projects.title: Village learning center
projects.description: A safe space with teachers, computers and a small library for 200 children.
projects.imageAlt: Children studying at the village learning center

detail.lead: A bright, welcoming place where children can learn after school, discover new interests and imagine more possibilities for their future.
detail.quote: When a child has a safe place to learn, the whole village starts to see what is possible.

sections.title: A room made for curiosity
sections.description: Local teachers lead reading, computer and homework sessions in a space designed around the way children learn best.

sections.title: Built with the community
sections.description: Parents and local leaders helped shape the center, from the library shelves to the daily timetable, so it belongs to everyone.

projects.title: Community kitchen
projects.description: Hot meals served daily to 300 families through a team of local volunteers.
projects.imageAlt: Volunteers serving meals at the community kitchen

detail.lead: Every morning, volunteers turn donated ingredients into nutritious meals that bring families together around one shared table.
detail.quote: A warm meal is practical support, but it is also dignity, welcome and a reason to feel hopeful.

sections.title: From ingredients to plates
sections.description: Local suppliers and careful planning keep the kitchen stocked, while volunteers prepare fresh food for the day ahead.

sections.title: A table for everyone
sections.description: The kitchen serves children, parents and older neighbours without barriers, creating a dependable place to eat and connect.

projects.title: Mobile health clinic
projects.description: Check-ups, medicine and a friendly face delivered to remote villages.
projects.imageAlt: A health worker examining a patient in a village

detail.lead: The clinic travels beyond the nearest hospital so families can receive check-ups, medicine and trusted health advice close to home.
detail.quote: The first step toward better health is making care reachable.

sections.title: Care on the road
sections.description: A small medical team follows a regular route through remote communities, bringing essential equipment and supplies with them.

sections.title: More than a check-up
sections.description: Alongside treatment, the team shares practical guidance that helps families prevent illness and make confident decisions about their health.

cta.title: Help the next project reach further.
cta.description: Every contribution helps local teams turn a good idea into practical support for a whole community.
